passage: On Saturday morning, forty volunteers spread out along Gull Point Beach with gloves and bags. They worked for three hours, picking up bottles, fishing line, and plastic wrappers. ______ they collected more than 200 pounds of trash.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
steps: The final sentence sums up the total result of the work just described.
"In all" signals a total or summary.
There is no contrast, nothing unexpected ("Nevertheless"), and the total is not an example ("For instance").
key: Summary transitions (in all, overall) introduce a total or conclusion.
